title: edm-stop-gate alone captures edm-hookify with 2>&1 and prints only on block, silently swallowing every warn match and setup error; edm-gateguard and edm-bash-gate let both through
harness_scratch_dir at 4217 replaces wave6's own four-arm cleanup_wave6 traps, disarming the tracked-file restore 800 lines BEFORE the T41 block that mutates docs/canonical-sections.md
code-audit SKILL's False Alarm Filter says 'do not report as a finding'; all 14 lens agents say the filter demotes and never deletes, and that NOTED items still get a JSONL line
wave8-smoke.sh calls harness_scratch_dir 14 times against one shared trap global; the call at 311 orphans T05_TMP's own traps and T05_TMP has no explicit rm, so it leaks on every run

edm-bash-gate guards its jq payload projection with '|| exit 0' plus an emptiness check; edm-gateguard runs the structurally identical projection unguarded under set -e, so a jq failure aborts the gate outside its documented 0/1/2 contract
edm-gateguard is the only one of the four hook consumers running 'set -euo pipefail'; edm-hookify, edm-stop-gate and edm-bash-gate all use 'set -uo pipefail' with no comment explaining the split

--help alias set diverges inside the hook-consumer family: edm-gateguard accepts '-h|--help|help', the other three accept only '-h|--help', and four bin/ scripts document a set narrower than the one they accept

edm-bash-gate and edm-stop-gate silently ignore every positional argument; edm-gateguard dies on any argument and edm-hookify dies on an unknown subcommand, so a typo'd flag reads as a normal hook invocation on two of four

Three of four hook consumers route untrusted text through a named single sanitizing emit point (emit_decision / hookify_emit_match / stop_gate_emit_blocking); edm-bash-gate, the newest, inlines a raw printf to stderr with no emit function and no sanitizer

edm-hookify hand-rolls resolve_project_root instead of sourcing _edm-datadir-lib.sh's edm_project_key, the library AD3 designates as the sole owner of that chain; terminal fallback differs ('.' vs pwd)

edm-audit-security.md is the sole lens of fifteen that hard-wraps the house boilerplate, breaking contract part 3's 'byte-identical across every lens' clause while CLAUDE.md names it one of the two files verified in full

Seven of fourteen lens files carry an extra top-level section under four different names for one role, one of them in a different position; the T28 checker's waiver comment names only three files and two names

_rr_validate_output captures edm-state validate's exit status and then discards it; edm-stop-gate switches on the same documented 0/3/other contract, so a validate setup error scores State health as clean instead of unknown

The two consumers of _edm-datadir-lib.sh guard sourcing with different predicates ('[[ -f ]]' in edm-gateguard, '[[ -r ]]' in edm-state); a readable-but-not-readable file aborts the set -e gate instead of degrading

edm-repo-readiness derives 'active initiatives' from 'edm-state list | awk /phase=/' while edm-stop-gate uses the dedicated active-initiatives subcommand; the two sets differ (phase 0 and 7 included vs excluded)
Five scratch dirs in wave8-smoke.sh use a third idiom -- bare mktemp -d with no trap and a trailing rm a signal skips -- alongside the file's hand-rolled-trap and harness_scratch_dir idioms
CA-529 re-verified: all fifteen edm-audit-*.md files now carry byte-identical tools/disallowedTools/model/effort/maxTurns/color lines in the same key order; the synthesizer's grant no longer diverges
edm-bash-gate emits no diagnostic on any of its five bail-out paths while edm-stop-gate's soft_exit names its internal conditions -- plausibly deliberate, since this hook fires on every Bash call
Two hook-body guard idioms in hooks.json ('&& cmd || true' vs '|| exit 0; cmd') track the advisory-versus-blocking split exactly; the divergence is functional, not drift
die() default exit 1 in edm-gateguard/edm-hookify versus the family-standard 2 elsewhere is documented in-file and in each help block: 2 already means block on a hook consumer
The same function-presence probe is written 'declare -f' at three sites and 'declare -F' at five across edm-state and edm-gateguard; behaviourally identical here, style-only divergence
